messages:
Jordan: thinking out loud — can we assemble a tiny, curated snippet bank of deploy/release CLI commands + short templates for fast ops? want low-friction stuff people can paste during a change window or incident.
Sam: yes. totally. something like 1-line canary start, 1-line rollback, and a few release-note stubs?
Elaine: +1. also add a standard dry-run command that validates manifests and checks pin compatibility. saves the back-and-forth.
Nate: idea: expose a small set of aliases that the deploy-bot understands (e.g. `rb` => rollback last, `can8` => start 8% canary). keep them explicit so we avoid accidental triggers.
Sam: agree on aliases. also include quick guard flags for change windows, e.g. `--window-id` to tie to calendar event and `--safety-check` that refuses outside window.
Jordan: rough examples I was thinking of (feel free to copy/paste into a snippet file):
```
# start a small canary pinned to v2.3.1, 5% traffic, dry-run check first
/release start --model web-service --version v2.3.1 --canary 5 --dry-run && /release apply --confirm

# rollback alias (rb) - revert to previous stable within 1min window
/release rb --to previous --force-if-safe

# change window guarded deploy
/release start --version v2.3.2 --window-id 2026-03-21-ops --safety-check
```
Elaine: nice. add a snippet for pin annotation that shows why a pin was set (notes) so audits and alerting tie to a reason. e.g. `--pin-reason "fastpatch memory leak"`
deploy-bot: reminder: when using `--safety-check` the bot will run unit canaries, perf smoke, and gate on latency SLOs. Use `--bypass` with a human-approved token only.
Nate: question: where should these live? small `release/snippets.md` in the repo? or a snippet-management endpoint in the console?
Sam: store canonical ones in the docs repo under `ops/release-snippets.md` and add a quick `snippets` subcommand to the CLI that prints them. we can also let the bot fetch them by name (`/release snippet canary-small`).
Jordan: love that. followups: 1) I'll prototype a 8-10 snippet file and open a PR. 2) Nate can add the CLI `snippets` subcommand patch. 3) Elaine will draft the pin-reason template and examples.
Elaine: will do. I'll include a short checklist for post-deploy notes and required fields for a pin (reason, author, link to issue).
Sam: putting an ops-owners review step on PRs for the snippet file makes sense. small change — +1 from me.
release-helper-bot: created checklist issue #342: "Snippet bank + CLI print subcommand" assigned to Jordan, Nate, Elaine. ETA: 2d.
Jordan: thanks — I'll drop the PR link when ready. keeping everything intentionally minimal so ppl actually use it. :memo:
